mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{roleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT permission_id, effect FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT rp.permission_id, rp.effect FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY rp.permission_id, rp.effect
mapper.select: SELECT effect FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
SELECT permission_id, effect FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (id, role_id, permission_id, effect) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{effect})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
